title: VDGR-RAG: Vectors, Directories, Graphs, and Reflection Are All You Need for Unified Reasoning over Hierarchical Enterprise Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2608.07994v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is essential for enterprise knowledge question answering (QA), particularly in domains with complex product documentation like telecommunications. However, existing RAG approaches largely overlook the holistic integration of diverse retrieval strengths, leading to inaccurate domain routing, poor utilization of hierarchical document structures, and consequently limited reasoning capabilities over enterprise knowledge. translated_title: VDGR-RAG：向量、目录、图谱与反思——面向层级企业知识统一推理的全部所需
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）对于企业知识问答（QA）至关重要，尤其是在电信等具有复杂产品文档的领域。然而，现有RAG方法在很大程度上忽视了不同检索优势的整体整合，导致领域路由不准确、对层级文档结构利用不足，从而限制了企业知识上的推理能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出了VDGR-RAG，它在统一框架中整合了向量检索、目录驱动推理、图谱遍历和迭代反思，以实现准确的企业知识问答。具体而言，VDGR-RAG是一个智能体式图RAG系统，首先从文档块构建层级异构知识图谱（$\text{H}^2$KG），以保留层级目录结构和语义关系，然后采用一组原子...
tldr: VDGR-RAG通过统一整合向量检索、目录驱动、图谱遍历与反思机制，构建层级异构知识图谱，解决了现有RAG在企业知识问答中路由不准和层级利用不足的问题。
en_tdlr: VDGR-RAG unifies vector retrieval, directory-driven reasoning, graph traversal, and reflection via a hierarchical heterogeneous knowledge graph, addressing inaccurate routing and poor hierarchical utilization in enterprise knowledge QA.
